full_prompt_en: A square experimental portrait shows a young adult in sharp right-facing profile against a flat, saturated orange background. The smooth background fills every corner and gives no clue to a physical setting. A rounded bowl haircut forms a matte silver-gray cap over the head, with closely ordered strands catching soft highlights. Below the hairline, the ear, face, neck, and clothing are covered in minute, interlocking swirls and dotted color marks. Electric cyan, magenta, yellow, lime, and deep blue follow the contours of the skin, making the features readable while turning their surface into a dense graphic field. The eye looks toward the right edge; the straight nose, closed lips, and clean jawline are modeled with narrow bands of cooler blue shadow. A high collar rises under the chin and joins a structured jacket with broad shoulders. On the jacket, nested curves and short repeating marks change scale along seams and lapels, with a small dark fastening near the collar. The figure occupies the right-center of the frame, leaving a broad uninterrupted orange area to the left and above. Bright frontal light keeps the profile crisp and makes the upper cheek and hair gleam, while a modest shadow under the chin separates head and collar. The color treatment feels printed or digitally painted over a realistic three-dimensional portrait, combining photographic volume with extremely fine decorative detail. The overall composition sets a calm, precise silhouette against a hot monochrome field, letting the patterned surface carry most of the visual energy.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形实验性肖像在平坦而饱和的橙色背景前呈现一名年轻成年人清晰的右向侧面。平滑背景填满每个角落，没有任何实体场景线索。圆弧形齐刘海发型像哑光银灰帽盖住头部，整齐发丝接住柔和亮光。发际线以下，耳、面部、颈部和衣服布满微细而互相咬合的旋纹与点状彩色笔画。电青、洋红、黄、酸橙绿和深蓝顺着皮肤轮廓延伸，使五官仍然可辨，同时把表面变成密集图形区域。眼睛望向右缘；挺直鼻梁、闭合嘴唇和干净下颌由狭窄的冷蓝阴影带塑形。高领立在下巴之下，连接一件肩部宽阔且有结构的夹克。夹克上的套叠曲线和重复短笔画沿接缝与翻领改变尺度，领旁有一处小型深色扣合点。人物占据画面中右部，让左侧和上方留出宽阔、不受打断的橙色区域。明亮的正面光保持侧面轮廓清晰，让上颊与头发发亮，下巴下方的适度阴影则分开头部和衣领。色彩处理仿佛印在或数字绘在真实三维肖像上，把摄影般体积与极细装饰细节结合。整体构图以平静准确的剪影对照炽热的单色背景，让图案表面承担大部分视觉能量。
style_prompt_en: The image combines realistic, smoothly modeled volume with saturated graphic color and densely printed-looking micro-pattern. Hot orange, cyan, magenta, yellow, lime, and blue meet in high-energy contrast; broad flat fields give relief to intricate multicolor areas. Repeated dots, tight curves, and contour-following lines create a shimmering surface while preserving the underlying form. The focal edge is crisp against an unbroken backdrop, and a few cool shadows provide depth without muting the palette. Light is bright and controlled, with small clean highlights on raised planes and limited cast shadow. Large negative space offsets compact visual density, making the pattern read from both near and far. The overall effect is synthetic, exuberant, and precisely ordered.
style_prompt_zh: 图像把真实而平滑塑造的体积与饱和图形色彩、密集如印刷的微型纹样结合。炽热橙、电青、洋红、黄、酸橙绿与蓝形成高能反差；宽阔平坦色域为繁复多彩区域提供喘息。重复细点、紧密曲线和顺形体延伸的线条制造闪烁表面，同时保留底层结构。焦点边缘在不间断背景前十分清楚，少量冷色阴影提供纵深而不压低色彩。光线明亮受控，凸起平面上有干净的小高光，投影有限。大片负空间平衡紧凑的视觉密度，使纹样从远近都可辨读。整体效果人工合成感强、欢腾且秩序精密。
theme_en: A color-patterned side-profile portrait against orange
theme_zh: 橙色背景前布满彩色纹样的侧面肖像
name: Neil Harbisson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
